name: NSQ Open-Source Distributed Messaging
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed distributed real-time publish/subscribe and queue-based messaging software; self-hosted binaries and Docker deployment without vendor-imposed message, topic or consumer quotas.
watch_out: No free managed broker, compute, storage, networking, backups or SLA is included. You operate nsqd/nsqlookupd, security, monitoring and data durability; at-least-once delivery requires idempotent consumers. Preserve MIT license notices.
